title: Close-up lesion image -> visual health classified with confidence

source.transform: EXIF-upright crop box (573, 122, 1740, 952) (fractional 0.28-0.85 x / 0.08-0.62 y) of the source image, longest side resized to 1200px, JPEG q90. Deterministic -- same box every run.
source.notes: the source photo has real red hand-drawn skin marks on the pig's flank/back (visible in the cropped region) resembling a lesion/marking close-up -- not a synthetic overlay.

cascade.source: observed on host by docs/plan-phase-4/2-host-verification.md (docs/logs/phase4-health-cascade-host.md, cascade_natural column) with the shipped manifest; not yet asserted by any test

notes: Confirmed by task 1's phase-4 run (observed_phase4 below): view resolves health_only (confidence 0.9682) as hypothesized, but the live weight-branch reason is view_not_dorsal, not weight_needs_reference_object -- the latter is a dead WeightEligibilityChecker reason (finding 5) that the live pipeline never emits.

observed_phase4.method: test/support/native_harness.dart directly (not through the permanent Tier B test file, which is written in task 4), INSTAHAM_NATIVE_TESTS=1, Windows host build from build/windows-host/Release/, no cm_per_px supplied for any fixture (see note per fixture).
